title: Special Topics in News Writing and Reporting; Sports Betting and College Sports II
description:
Prerequisite: JOUR320. JOUR328N must be taken concurrently with JOUR328M.

Legalized sports betting is changing the landscape of sports at every level. The impact on college sports is especially complicated. The National Collegiate Athletic Association bans athletes from betting on sports, professional or college. But on college campuses, the popularity of sports betting is growing rapidly. In this course, students examine and report on the present and future impact of sports betting on colleges from multiple perspectives: University presidents, athletic directors, coaches, athletes and students, among others.
